data.name: Adesh
data.long_meaning: Adesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अदेश’ (adesh), which means 'command' or 'order'. It is a powerful name that signifies authority, leadership, and control. In Hindu mythology, Adesh is also the name of the God of Kshatriyas, the warrior caste, who governs and upholds dharma in society.
